summary: The census counts an unmarried student in a dorm as living in the parents' home.
realLife: The Current Population Survey counts unmarried college students in dormitories as living in their parents' home.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, Census Bureau Releases New Estimates on America's Families and Living Arrangements (Nov 17, 2026): https://www.census.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026/new-estimates-on-families-and-living-arrangements.html
inGame: the college-started life event and the household membership; needs: a dorm or off-campus address on the college record.

turns.what: A student who lives off campus on their own lease and is counted at that address.
turns.writesBack: a separate household at the college year

turns.what: A student who commutes from a parent's house, counted there without any change.
